visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide-angle handheld shot of the Tokyo Dome's exterior under an overcast sky. A massive crowd of people is seen gathered in the plaza area in front of the building's distinctive white lattice roof. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a large outdoor merchandise board titled 'Übermensch G-DRAGON 2025 WORLD TOUR'. Numerous items on the list, including shirts and accessories, are marked with red 'SOLD OUT' stickers. (3) A hand with a ring points to a specific item on the list, emphasizing its unavailability. The lighting is natural but flat due to the cloudy weather. (4) The camera focuses on a pair of hands holding and rapidly flipping through a stack of polaroid-style photocards. Each card features an artist with bright green hair and varied expressions. (5) The final sequence shows high-contrast footage from a concert screen. A male artist, G-Dragon, is performing in a textured red feathered jacket and dark sunglasses, holding a microphone amidst red stage lighting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-tempo K-pop hip-hop track featuring a heavy electronic drum beat and sharp synth stabs. A male artist performs a rapid, rhythmic rap with a raspy, energetic vocal delivery. (2) At the midpoint, the audio switches to a live concert recording of the same song. The vocal quality becomes more spacious with stadium echo, and the mix is suddenly flooded with high-pitched screaming and cheering from a large crowd. The percussive bass hits become deeper and more resonant, simulating the acoustic environment of a large dome.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a fan vlog documenting the high demand for G-Dragon concert merchandise at the Tokyo Dome. It highlights the disappointment of items being 'sold out' while showcasing the exclusive photocards obtained, ultimately transitioning into live footage to share the concert atmosphere.
